entries.b464047c2d9a9b87: This business manufactures and sells foods such as dressings, sauces, retort foods, frozen foods and soups. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,094 million. The main product, Pietro Dressing Wafu Shoyu, is an unheated, raw-type dressing; the majority of sales are made through wholesalers (accounts) to mass merchandisers and supermarkets nationwide. It is manufactured at the factory in Koga City, Fukuoka Prefecture, and consolidated subsidiaries PIETRO NORTH AMERICA, INC. in the United States and GODO KAISHA KONOBEJIFAAMU in Japan each carry out the Products Business in their respective markets.

entries.b79cb7ae6e822601: Under the philosophy of "valuing fans," the company states that it will further strengthen fan-based management, and in the product business, with the dressing category as its earnings base, it will work on business diversification with pasta, frozen foods, and soups, in addition to the delicatessen and food service business and the overseas business, as new pillars of growth. In the store business, the company states that, while improving the quality of the customer experience, it will develop area marketing that positions restaurants as experience-type brand communication bases. Also, it will relocate and consolidate production equipment to a new plant in Koga City, Fukuoka Prefecture, and plans to start full-scale operation at the new base in September 2026, and in April 2027 it plans to open "PIETRO FACTORY PARK," a complex facility using the new plant.
